title: St. Ives: Being the Adventures of a French Prisoner in England
summary: A novel following the adventures of a French prisoner of war in early nineteenth-century England. The narrator recounts his experiences as an interpreter and pawn in British military life, detailing prison routines, duels, court intrigues, and romantic entanglements within Edinburgh Castle. Through witty narration, he navigates camaraderie with fellow prisoners, clashes with officious officers like Major Chevenix, and pursues a delicate romance with an English lady named Flora. Themes of honor, captivity, cultural dislocation, and survival in adversity are interwoven with humor and irony as the protagonist recounts his resourcefulness, duels, escapes, and eventual unexpected rescue by a London solicitor.
